run_pairwise_distances_benchmark: run a benchmark script that computes pairwise distances between query and database vectors using faiss
run_benchmark_with_metric: run the pairwise distance benchmark with a custom metric like L1 or L2 passed as a CLI argument
test_pairwise_distances: test the SIMD implementation of pairwise distance computations for various faiss metrics
create_random_vectors: create random numpy arrays using faiss.randn for benchmarking pairwise distance calculations
benchmark_metric_performance: benchmark the performance of different faiss distance metrics on random vector datasets
